description: A reset handler re-renders its interpolation (§6.1). @count starts at 5; one click on #reset runs clearCount(), writing 0; #display and the snapshot both read 0. Sibling of reset-handler: that case ends on an inc, so it no longer asserts the display right after clearCount(); this one does, and because the initial state (5) differs from the asserted end state (0), it fails if the handler or the write does nothing.
rationale: §6.1 reactive cells: a write from a handler (clearCount sets @count to 0) updates the cell AND re-renders every interpolation that reads it. Starting from a non-zero value makes the reset observable in both the DOM and the state.
